'''Gone Courting''' is a cutscene in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] assigned to [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] by countryside criminal [[Catalina]] from her [[Catalina's Hideout|hideout]] in [[Fern Ridge]], [[Red County]], [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].

==Outline==
Catalina shows her love to Carl by tying him up and torturing him. This mission unlocks two out of a possible of four robbery missions given by Catalina.

*''' ''Case A''. Tanker Commander and Small Town Bank were completed beforehand in First Date and First Base, irrespective of order :-'''
**[[Against All Odds]]
**[[Local Liquor Store]]
*''' ''Case B''. Tanker Commander and Against All Odds were completed beforehand in First Date and First Date, irrespective of order :-'''
**[[Local Liquor Store]]
**[[Small Town Bank]]
*''' ''Case C''. Tanker Commander and Local Liquor Store were completed beforehand in First Date and First Base, irrespective of order :-'''
**[[Against All Odds]]
**[[Small Town Bank]]
*''' ''Case D''. Small Town Bank and Local Liquor Store were completed beforehand in First Date and First Base, irrespective of order :-'''
**[[Against All Odds]]
**[[Tanker Commander]]
*''' ''Case E''. Small Town Bank and Against All Odds were completed beforehand in First Date and First Base, irrespective of order :-'''
**[[Local Liquor Store]]
**[[Tanker Commander]]
*''' ''Case F''. Local Liquor Store and Against All Odds were completed beforehand in First Date and First Base, irrespective of order :-'''
**[[Small Town Bank]]
**[[Tanker Commander]]

==Script==
'''(''Carl arrives at Catalina's door.'')'''

'''CJ''': Hey, Catalina, its Carl! C'mon, let's go, we got banks to rob, baby. Come on, let's go.

'''Catalina''': (''seductively'') In here, mi amor.

'''CJ''': A'ight, come on. Let's go.

'''Catalina''': (''angrily'') You get your sorry ass in here right now, Carl Johnson, or I shove a fucking hand grenade up it!

'''CJ''': A'ight, I'm coming. Look baby, I really need that paper! Oh, my God. What in hell's name is that?

'''Catalina''': This, you fucking prick? This is a rack! I'm gonna torture your sorry ass!

'''CJ''': No, baby. No. Please no.

'''Catalina''': You never write to me! You don't call! You treat me like a fucking whore! Like one of YOUR whores!

'''CJ''': No, baby, please, I ain't into that shit!

'''Catalina''': I'm gonna fuck you up!

'''(''Catalina whips Carl.'')'''

'''CJ''': Oh, baby, please no. Please, baby, no! Ow! Eh! Ooh! Aw! Ouch! Damn! Oh shit!

'''Catalina''': Yes! Faster! Harder! Deeper! Oh, yes! Yes! Yes!

'''(''Carl and Catalina become silent,'')'''

'''CJ''': Maybe we can go out and rob now?
